## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal change
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (bug fixes start with a failing test)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` run and the updated `dist/` bundles are committed (if `src/` or `mcp/` changed)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private data in the diff

## Notes for reviewers

Anything you want a reviewer to look at closely.
